description: Xogot brings the full power of the Godot game engine to iPad. With a native iPad experience designed for touch, you can make, play, and share games wherever inspiration strikes. Xogot gives you everything you need to build 2D and 3D games — all from your iPad.
detailed_description: Xogot is a game development platform that brings the power of the Godot game engine to the iPad, allowing developers to create both 2D and 3D games on the go. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools, including touch-friendly scene editors, an integrated code editor, and a debugger. This setup enables developers to work seamlessly across multiple devices, thanks to compatibility with the desktop Godot editor. Xogot solves the problem of limited game development capabilities on mobile devices by providing a full-fledged development environment. It supports multitasking features like Stage Manager and utilizes Apple Pencil for precise editing. The app is designed to be portable and approachable, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced developers. Xogot is built on Godot 4.4 and includes features like WebAssembly export for easy sharing of games. However, it has limitations such as only supporting GDScript and lacking native GDExtensions due to Apple policies.
features: Touch-friendly 2D and 3D scene editors with native floating toolbars, allowing for intuitive game development on the iPad.
Integrated code editor with syntax highlighting and autocomplete for GDScript and shaders, enhancing coding efficiency.
Full debugging experience with features like stepping, variable inspection, and stack-traces, which helps in identifying and fixing errors.
Support for multitasking with Stage Manager, enabling developers to work across multiple displays and devices.
Compatibility with external inputs like Bluetooth controllers, keyboards, and trackpads for playtesting, providing a comprehensive testing environment.
